# ADR-007: Bound optional analysis and retain incomplete layers

Status: chosen

Concerns: Q-evidence, Q-reproduce

## Decision

Use compiler records, emitted XML and narrow typed semantics for current generation. Keep Joern/CodeQL/SVF/PhASAR/KLEE roles and incomplete layers explicit.

## Rationale

Neither produces missing runtime behavior or valid proof evidence. The selected scalar rule has no unresolved pointer-flow question.

## Alternatives

Require every analyzer to process the entire source before translation; label arbitrary JSON a CPG.

## Consequences

Full compile configurations and required graph/semantic questions must still be resolved before overall acceptance.
